==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in outer space. The sky is red. It is full of colorful, crystal, planets with irregular round shapes.

I can hop from one planet to another. I do so while running on all fours. I feel as free as a wild animal.

I have no responsibilities. I feel as if I had a mission at some point. I am dressed in an emerald leather uniform, but I can't remember what organization I am a part of.
